mapper.select: SELECT id, skill_name AS skillName, description, enabled, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM skill ORDER BY skill_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (skill_name, description) VALUES (#{skillName}, #{description}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description)
mapper.update: UPDATE skill SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE skill_name = #{skillName}
mapper.select: SELECT tool_name AS skillName, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, AVG(cost_ms) AS avgCostMs, MAX(create_time) AS lastCalledAt FROM agent_tool_step WHERE create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT agent_code AS agentCode, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IS NULL OR status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, AVG(cost_ms) AS avgCostMs, MAX(create_time) AS lastCalledAt FROM agent_tool_step WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND agent_code IS NOT NULL AND agent_code <> '' GROUP BY agent_code ORDER BY calls DESC
